headline: Item 2 (finite-bias leak) FIXED and byte-identical on every realistic arm. Item 3 (apa.cpp top-left) FIXED, source-verified plus labeled stub-harness execution; the extension cannot be built here (torch cu130 vs nvcc 12.x). Item 1: B1/B2/B3 FIXED; real-data agreement with BK4 'h' rises from 0.99868-0.99949 to 0.9999971-1.0. Bit-exactness is NOT reached (G2a RED): exact only in 5/36 real and 57/72 synthetic cells. The residual is (R1) BK4's bf16-WMMA dot bits, which no engine op reproduces, plus (R3) BK4's FFMA variance arithmetic, which at count-1 rows makes the kernel drop the row's only key. That is the registered stop-and-report rail.

open_items: Exact BK4 parity needs an engine/kernel change: a selection op that reuses bk3::scores WMMA dots and BK4's sequential FADD/FFMA statistics (or exposes BK4's thr), or the lead accepts the in-band residual. Decision: lead/David.
BK4 count-1 artifact: kernel drops a row's only visible key when RN(a^2) > a^2 (cancellation in one-pass variance). Kernel finding; not edited.
BK4 'h' and the shipped 'a' kernel disagree with each other on 0-184 entries per real cell (1430 total), more than MF2 vs 'a' (364).
S<L out-of-contract rows are now NaN: decide whether test_mf1_quant_s_less_than_l_is_finite should be updated, or fully masked rows kept finite.
Quantizer overflow: |k| > ~1.8e19 (fp32 |k|^2) or a reconstructed fp16 key past 65504 gives a non-finite bulk score (pre-existing).
tensor_gpu_v2/_core.py (10+ sites) and apa_cuda/tests/test_parity.py reference still use a finite -1e9 fill: not writable, listed.
GRAPA scripts/cc39b_which_op.py:125 MASK_BIAS = -1e4 mirrors the old engine constant (now stale).
apa_cuda extension build needs a CUDA 13 toolkit (or a cu12 torch).
GRM apa KL at 5% resolution needs a longer or multi-window evaluation.
